title: Runtime seeding harness and thermal-aware performance profile publisher for cross-sku onboarding
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Build a runtime seeding and probe harness that captures transient thermal and power-influenced performance characteristics across target GPU SKUs (A100 / H100 / L40S / MI300). The harness will produce signed performance artifacts suitable for automated publishing to the performance profile registry used by onboarding and pinning workflows. This ticket covers (1) the probe design and warmup sequence to stabilize KV/cache behavior, (2) thermal-aware sampling windows to detect throttling or hysteresis, (3) deterministic signature generation for pin recommendations, and (4) the publisher integration with the profile service and console metadata. Goal is to reduce noisy pin churn from transient tail events and produce stable per-device signatures for model onboarding and automated pin suggestions.
acceptance_criteria: Harness runs end-to-end on each target SKU (A100/H100/L40S/MI300) and emits a signed profile artifact (JSON) with p50/p95/p99 latency, throughput, KV-cache footprint, and thermal event histogram.
Profiles include confidence metadata (num_samples, warmup_duration, variance_score) and a deterministic signature hash used by the pinning recommender.
Publisher uploads artifacts to the profile registry and surfaces a publish event in the Console release channel with links to the sample run Grafana dashboard and commit PR.
Canary gating rules in the publisher prevent publishing if transient thermal events exceed configured thresholds (configurable per-SKU).

End-to-end test with a sample model (50M context synthetic workload) demonstrates reduced pin flip rate in synthetic drift test compared to baseline harness v0 (>= 40% reduction in pin churn over 24h).
tasks: Design probe sequence: cold-run, controlled warmup, steady-state sampling windows (ENG, 2d)
Implement seeding harness library with per-sku tuning knobs and KV-warmup primitives (ENG, 3d)
Add thermal and power sampling hooks (nvidia-smi/power telemetry + hw counters) (ENG, 2d)
Schema for profile artifact and deterministic signature algorithm (ENG + PM, 1d)
Publisher integration: sign artifact, upload to registry, emit console event and webhook (ENG, 2d)
Create CI job that runs harness on our edge fleet gating nodes and validates signature reproducibility (ENG, 1d)
Define canary gating thresholds and add to publishing pipeline (PM + Eng, 1d)
Write doc and runbook for interpreting thermal-aware profiles for SRE/solutions (DES/PM, 1d)
comments: 2026-02-11 - Marco Nguyen: Initial spike for warmup sequence done. Cold-to-warm transition at 12s looks reproducible on L40S but H100 shows a longer stabilization window (~18-22s). Need to parameterize warmup duration per-SKU.

2026-02-16 - Aisha Kumar: Reviewed thermal hooks design. We should capture both instantaneous throttling events and windowed thermal trend to separate transient spikes from sustained throttling. Added thermal_event_histogram to artifact schema.

2026-02-20 - Marco Nguyen: Implemented deterministic signature using SHA256 over canonicalized metric keys + seed. Verified signature is stable across runs when sample_count >= 3 and warmup >= configured per-sku minimum.

2026-02-24 - QA (Lena Ortiz): Ran harness across fleet gating nodes (A100 x6, H100 x6, L40S x4, MI300 x2). Observed one MI300 node with repeated power capping events; flagged as fleet anomaly (see ENG-275430).

2026-03-01 - PM Review (Carlos Vega): Approved publishing flow pending addition of canary thresholds for p99 tail and thermal event rate. Also requested a dashboard tile in Console to compare newly published signatures against historical baselines.
